newsitem.title: USA: CME hog, pork belly futures settle mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog, pork belly futures settle mixed.

text.p: CME hog and pork belly futures ended mixed Friday, with December hogs up on commodity fund buying and ideas that pork product prices have hit a near-term bottom, CME traders said.
Talk circulating on the trading floor and in cash markets that Japan bought chilled pork loins also helped to lift nearby hog contracts, traders and analysts said.
No tonnage for the purchase was cited or could be confirmed, but traders said any indication that Japan was re-entering the U.S. pork market would be bullish for hog futures.
December and February hogs were also boosted by short covering, floor traders said.
